messages:
Anya: Quick favor — can someone run a sigtest sweep for the tiny-batch config on rtm-staging? Need throughput + tail-latency checks across batch_sizes [1,2,4,8] and max_tokens [64,128,256]. PR open with scheduler tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/488 — CI showed a flaky spike at batch=4 / max_tokens=128. Also would appreciate a fast CR on cb/scheduler change. Example loadgen command below:

Anya: ```
loadgen --target rtm-staging --config tinybatch.yaml \n  --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --max-tokens 64,128,256 \n  --duration 90s --out ./results.json
```

Mike: I can run it in ~30m. Quick note: set --warmup 20s to stabilize KV cache, otherwise first-window spikes. :thumbsup:

Sam: I can review the PR now, will focus on lease handling and metric tags. Leaving a few inline comments already.

bench-bot: Started job j-9823 on rtm-staging with configs tinybatch.yaml, batch_sizes=[1,2,4,8], max_tokens=[64,128,256], duration=90s. Logs: https://ci.redwood/j-9823

Ashley: If you want better signal for regressions, add `--sampling=percent:10` to capture request traces (helps correlate prompt shapes).

Leo: Heads up — there was a kernel bump on staging yesterday that affected scheduling. Recommend running the sweep twice and diffing results.

Mike: Run 1 complete. Quick numbers: batch=4 / max_tokens=128 => p50=48ms, p95=210ms, p99=430ms (spike). Other combos look fine. Gist with raw output: https://gist.github.com/mike/bench-tinybatch-1

Mike: Re-running with --warmup 30s and sampling enabled.

Anya: Thanks — if you can, upload the results + logs to the PR and tag @Sam. If the p99 regression holds we'll need to tweak small-batch fallback and maybe reduce soft_lease window.

Sam: Left review comments. Main code nit: cb/scheduler.go line ~214 — prefer time.AfterFunc in the lease path instead of blocking time.Sleep to avoid blocking other handoffs. Also CI unit test failing for queueing: run `go test ./runtime -run TestQueueHandoff -v` locally and paste output so I can see the failure trace.

Mike: Running that test now. Output snippet: `--- PASS: TestQueueHandoff (0.12s)
=== RUN   TestQueueHandoff/hand_off_on_full
--- PASS: TestQueueHandoff/hand_off_on_full (0.04s)` — no obvious fail locally. Pushing full logs to the PR.

Anya: Let's hold merge until we get two clean sigtest runs and Sam's CR addressed. If the regression repros, plan B is to revert the scheduler change and roll back the canary. I'll update the runbook (runbook/tinybatch.md) with steps. :eyes:

bench-bot: Job j-9823 completed — 2 runs, no OOMs, avg throughput 2.6k tok/s, tinybatch-4-128 shows consistent p99 regression across runs. Tagging #eng-runtime for follow up and linking PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/488

Anya: OK — leaving this here for asynchronous follow-ups. @Mike @Sam please post final artifacts in the PR and I'll coordinate next steps tomorrow morning. Thanks!
